name: single_cell_500m
description: Zero-shear pulse cell at 500 m, the Phase 1 pipeline de-risking dataset. Migrated onto the Phase 2 scenario system as a pure refactor: every value here reproduces the Phase 1 cm1post/config.py constants exactly, so the re-export is byte-identical to the shipped package.

namelist._note: Scenario-defining overrides applied over the validated base deck. Only keys that characterise THIS scenario appear here; everything else comes from the base template and must not drift. Values verified against sim/single_cell/namelist.input.

export._note: Horizontal: measured union half-width was 24.25 km at THRESH=1e-6 (a superset of the 1e-4 export threshold), so 26 km pads it with margin. The cell is centred and stationary (imove=0), so a symmetric box keeps the bbox CENTRE STATIC at (0,0) -- the SVT constraint holds by construction. Vertical: measured union top was 16.75 km, padded to 18 km (a 1-voxel margin was judged too tight against threshold sensitivity). Derived grid: 208 x 208 x 72.
export._voxel_caveat: 250 m isotropic while the sim ran at 500 m -- this UPSAMPLES 2x and adds no physical detail. Intended for the Phase 1 spike: it tested the writer->SVT streaming path at realistic data volume and frame count, not science-grade fine structure.
